text: i rebuilt, it is still the same problem [Image #31]
resolution: Reproduced the surviving bug HEADLESSLY (new harness: RJIT_MODELDOC boots a cube model doc, RJIT_MESHOPS replays real gestures through the host doors, ZIGOS_SCREENSHOT captures — zero desktop access) and found the true live bake my first fix missed: applyFaceHighlight interleaved save/tint per face, and at low density both halves of a quad degenerate to overlapping centroid discs, so a later face's saved patch embedded an earlier face's tint; deselect wrote it back as paint. Single clicks never hit it — any MULTI-face selection (marquee, select-all, additive, outliner part select) baked, which matches the user's easy break exactly. Fix: reconcile now restores all then saves EVERY selected patch from the clean atlas BEFORE the first tint, so restore order is irrelevant. Verified headless: marquee/select-all/additive+clear all end orange-free, held selections still tint, undo restores colors; unit regression added (zig build test-mesh-edit passes). Needs a rebuild. Commits 485cdbe94 (atlas-rebuild bake paths + honest authored-face count) and 667235ba3 (the multi-face bake + harness).
